specs: Tandem jumps from 11,000 ft with about 5-6 minutes of freefall and parachute descent

blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving from 11,000 ft with freefall and parachute descent, or take AFF solo courses to become certified skydivers. Experienced jumpers can use the drop zone facilities and participate in fun jumps. Video and photo packages are available for tandem jumps and courses.
